10 August 2026 (v1.72)

NEW FEATURES

Boat Destinations
Everyone can now send their boat out on a world tour! Select from three different destinations with a variety of difficulties and choose the journey that suits you. Fill and send a boat to earn instant rewards, like vouchers, choice crates and puzzle pieces. When your boat sails home, it brings back Nautical Miles that unlock even more rewards on the Boat Voyage track, which refreshes every 3 days.

Building Mastery
Building Mastery brings a new method for mastery production buildings. You will receive a dedicated workbench screen to upgrade and level up all buildings on your farm. This feature will not be available to all players for now.

Farm Pass
After completing the monthly Farm Pass, you will soon be able to keep earning Farm Pass points and unlock even more rewards. Additionally, Farm Pass rewards can also be unlocked using Diamonds. You can expect these changes in September's Farm Pass.

BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS

Help Feature
When visiting a farm with active Help Requests, you will now see a few indicators pointing in the direction of the nearest Help Request. You can enable/disable this feature in the Advanced Settings.

Truck Orders
You can now "queue" multiple truck orders without needing to wait for the animation to finish.


15 June 2026 (v1.71)

A new update for Hay Day!

- Hay Day celebrates its 14th anniversary with music, rewards, music festival decorations, and special events.
- We are testing a new version of the Boat Orders experience with some players. Choose where your boat sails, pick your challenge, and earn rewards your way.
- A new beach area by the Sanctuary will become available this summer for beach and water decorations.
- Fixes and improvements to Seasonal Creatures, Choice Crates, events, rewards, and UI.


30 March 2026 (v1.70)

Truck track (beta test)

A brand-new feature that rewards you even more for completing truck orders!
This feature is currently being tested, so it may not be available to all players.

Boat improvements (beta test)

Boats have been reworked to feel smoother and more rewarding throughout the day:
- Boats return faster at the start of the day
- Orders begin easier and become more challenging over time
- Your first boats each day will have better rewards, including Expansion Material Choice Crates
These improvements are still being tested and may not be available to all players.

Sanctuary changes

You can now access Sanctuary animals without unlocking every expansion area.

New player experience

New players will experience a smoother start to their farming journey:
- Production buildings are now cheaper and faster to build
- Improved level-up rewards
- More truck orders available
- More fields available to purchase

Quality of life changes

You can now buy crops, axes, and saws with coins, with prices scaling with your Farm Level.


9 February 2026 (v1.69)

Love is in the air on the farm! This update brings a Valentine boat makeover, new emotes, and a smoother Task Event experience.

Valentine boat event
- For Valentine's, your boat turns pink! Fill those crates, help your neighbors, and earn sweet rewards while the event lasts.

New emotes
- New emotes will be released gradually so you can react, cheer, and chat in more fun ways.

Task Event UI improvements
- We've made improvements to the Task Event interface to make it easier to navigate and more accessible, so it's simpler to follow your tasks, progress, and rewards. This update will be released later.

Plus a few bug fixes to keep your farm running smoothly.


8 December 2025 (v1.68)

Hay Day Winter Update is here! The holiday season has arrived on the farm with fresh cozy content, smoother farming, and a few new features being tested with some players.

Holiday fun and new content - Maggie's got new winter looks for your farmhouse, Truck, and Roadside Shop. - The Gift Wrapping Station brings four festive gifts to craft. - Don't forget your advent calendar gifts on Greg's farm! 

- Keep an eye out... new Howlidays visitors will be arriving soon!

Quality of Life - Cancel queued products: remove items from a production queue before they start and get ingredients back (via Diamonds or an ad). - Rotate decorations, bushes, and trees even if they don't fit yet, perfect for planning layouts! 

- Faster help popups: tap through help-received messages without waiting for animations.

- Barn & Silo upgrade indicators: clearer hints when you're ready (or close!) to upgrade. - It's now simpler to discover active Neighborhoods. Find your people and start farming together! - Some changes to the Neighborhood chat, so it's simpler to stay in touch with your neighbors. Limited tests (rolling out to some players) - Fresh Beats: improved visuals, plus new ways to earn them through truck orders. - Choice Crates: new reward crates where you can choose what you want. - Level-up unlock flow: a small test to make unlocking the Boat feel better as you progress. Plus bug fixes and smaller improvements across the farm. Happy holidays in Hay Day!


21 September 2025 (v1.67)

Hey, farmers! Our latest update is here, packed with new ways to boost your farm, earn rewards, and enjoy the season in style. Here’s what’s new:

- Fresh Beats (Beta): We’re introducing a brand-new temporary perk that instantly boosts your crops, animals, or production for a short time. This early preview will be available for beta-testing to some players while we collect feedback and refine it. We’re looking forward to hearing the community's reaction to this feature before the full rollout.

- Tiny Trail: We are testing a bite-sized Truck Order Event running for just 4 days, with Diamonds & Coins as the main rewards. Since this is an early test, not everyone will see the event right away. We’ll be working on ways to bring it to more farmers, in the future.

- Surprise Boxes: A more intentional way to get the Decorations. Every box you open increases your chances of getting the reward you're hoping for.

- Seasonal Creatures: Limited-time visitors can appear on your farm, friends’ farms, or during special in-game events. Keep your eyes open, and you might see some guests appearing soon...

- Easier Tree & Bush Help Requests: We are making it easier to request help for bushes and trees. Drag the help sign across multiple fruit trees and bushes to request help all at once.

- New Animals & Decorations, including Pet Birds: Let's welcome to the farm; Blueberry Muffin, Blueberry Cheesecake, Brown Capybara Pup, Red Capybara Pup, Horse Stable, Scarlet Macaw, Hyacinth Macaw (Available in October).

- Derby Improvements: Multiple Derby bug fixes & improvements.


9 June 2025 (v1.66)

Hay Day turns 13, and everyone’s invited to the party!

Hey, Farmer! Whether you’ve been with us since day one or are just starting out, this birthday update is packed with special birthday treats, long-awaited improvements, and new features to make life on the farm even sweeter.

Hay Day Highlights • Take a walk down memory lane! View your farming stats and fun milestones in this brand-new feature.

New Game Content • Blueberry bushes are here! Use them to craft White Chocolate Blueberry Waffles. • A new pony arrives: the Shetland! • Welcome the Capybara to your Sanctuary!

Design Festival Upgrades • Explore your past designs in the new Gallery • Resubmit your creations and give them a fresh twist • Voting visibility now improves with more votes and task completion

Improved Farm Visitor Rewards • Visitors now reward you with XP and Barn & Silo parts — based on your level!


And a ton of Quality of Life Improvements to make your summer even better! Let’s make this birthday one to remember. See you on the farm!


17 March 2025 (v1.65)

Hey there, Farmer! The first signs of spring are here, and one of them is an all-new Hay Day update! Check out these fun new features:

Event Board Redesign - The event board is new and improved! It’s now easier to access events and save your favorites, so you don’t miss a beat. - Live April 1st for all players!

Chocolate Egg Maker - Produce delicious chocolate eggs in this new special production building – available for a limited time only!

Stickerbook Collection - You can now collect more than one reward from a Stickerbook Collection! More treats await at each milestone before you finish a collection.

Postman Decorations - Get a Wish Tree and a Combine Harvester to spruce up the homestead. Coming up in April!

And, as always, that’s not all! Tons of exciting events and sweet rewards are heading your way this spring!


9 December 2024 (v1.64)

Seasons greetings, Farmer! A chill is in the air, snow is falling, and that means that it's time for a winter update in Hay Day! We have plenty of delightful new content and features to look forward to.

New Crop - Time to get cozy with Chamomile! - This calming crop can be used to produce multiple new products for existing Production Buildings such as Chamomile Essential Oil from the Essential Oils Lab, a Soothing Pad from the Sewing Machine, and Chamomile Tea from the Tea Stand - Put Chamomile to use in a new Production Building, the Perfumerie

New Production Building - Welcome the Perfumerie to the Farm! - The Perfumery uses items from your Farm including the new crop Chamomile to create 3 products: a Fresh Diffuser, Zesty Perfume, and a Calming Diffuser perfect for a busy holiday season

New Birds - 3 lovely Swans land on the Farm over the next three months and can be unlocked with Chick Vouchers, with the first flying in this December

Holiday in Hay Day - Get ready for a new Temporary Production Building! The Gift Wrapping Station produces four different Gifts - Naughty or nice? A special Catalogue is here with plenty of adorable decorations, boosters, and more. Unlock whatever rewards your heart desires with this month's special currency: Holly - Maggie has new customizations for your Farmhouse, Roadside Shop, and Truck - Plus plenty of new decorations to bring holiday cheer to your Farm

And there's more on the way over the course of January and February with new events, decorations, and more! So bundle up, stay warm, and we will see you on the Farm!


7 October 2024 (v1.63)

Hey, Farmer! The seasons are changing, which means it's time for an update in Hay Day! We've spruced things up with plenty of new features and content releasing in October, and of course there's more to look forward to in November and December.

Halloween in Hay Day - Get ready for a new temporary production machine that produces four candy treats. No tricks here! - Halloween themed Farm Pass decorations, along with a spooky sweet animal accessory. - New Halloween decorations as well as plenty of customizations to be unlocked in Maggie's shop

Scenic Mode - Get ready for your closeup! With this new feature you can take stunning screenshots of your Farm, Town, and the Fishing area - You’ll find the Scenic Mode button in the hamburger menu. - Tap anywhere on the screen to exit Scenic Mode.

Improvements to Edit Mode User Experience - This improvement aims to unify the deco shop and edit mode as much as possible. - You asked, we listened! We've made requested changes to the functioning of Edit Mode, including the ability to erase by a swipe, and others!

Sanctuary Animals - Baby Ostriches are here! Don't miss out on these two cuties.

And there’s more on the way over the course of November and December, with new quality of life updates, decorations, events and more! See you on the Farm!


10 June 2024 (v1.62)

Time for a tune-up: It's Summertime in Hay Day!

New Features: - Farmer's Decoration Collection: Fuel your passion for collecting with themed decoration pages and earn fabulous rewards - Decoration Shop improvements: Easily find and purchase decorations with new categories and a filtering system - Surprise Boxes: new boxes packed with surprises and exclusive items can be found in the shop! - Early Bird Farm Pass: Kick off each month with a bundle that offers extra goodies and exclusive benefits

New Content: - New temporary Production Building: the Balloon Maker! Celebrate Hay Day's 12th Birthday with a new temporary Production Building given to all players. This building produces a set of celebratory Rock 'n' Roll style balloons!

New Decorations and Customizations: - Maggie has fresh Rock 'n' Roll customizations just in time for Summer for your House, Truck, and Roadside Shop! - Get ready to groove with a whole set of Rock 'n' Roll decorations for your Farm!

Fixes: - Farm Pass Chick: Just in! The Farm Pass chick will move 35% faster! - Freed up Storage: Purchasing Boosters from the Seasonal Catalogue will no longer take up storage space - Boost Events: Production Building Boost Events are now extended to players at level 14 - Friendbook updates: Search button graphics have been brought back, along with an update to the scroll area to improve readability

And, of course, we have more events, and decorations, plus lots more to come!


18 March 2024 (v1.61)

Time for a tune-up: It's Springtime in Hay Day!

What's new for the Sanctuary ?

  • New Sanctuary Animals: Ostriches are coming to Hay Day and are available to unlock, starting today!
  • Plus two decorations for your long-legged friends!

Production Buildings

  • Now in: The Essential Oils Lab is available to unlock starting today, plus two new Essential Oils to produce, and more coming soon! (Lemon Essential Oil and Mint Essential Oil)
  • Keep an eye out for a new temporary production building arriving for a limited time in March!


More Spring Fresh News

  • Coming soon: special events and decorations for St Patrick's Day, and Easter
  • Birds galore: a new pet bird will join the Farm later in April, stay tuned!
  • We've refreshed the Voucher and Decoration shops to improve your experience
  • And, of course, we have more events, and decorations, plus lots more to come!




27 November 2023 (v1.60)

New Milkshake Bar!

New Birthday Event!

New Omelet Station!

Spring Favorite: Asparagus is here!

Grandma dropped a new recipe!

SURPRISE! We've added an additional update with some aMOOzing new content to the game:

New Products:

  • You can now make delicious "Chocolate Waffles" in the Waffle Maker! :
  • A fresh and healthy salad can be produced now in the Salad Bar - the "Orange Salad"! :


New Decorations added to your Spin the Wheel rewards:

27 March 2023 (v1.57)

A new Update is live in Hay Day! Check out the EGGcellent new content that’s just been released:

  • A sweet new addition to Production Buildings: the Waffle Maker! Satisfy your sweet tooth with good old Plain Waffles or healthy Berry Waffles!
  • The Sanctuary welcomes two new lively animals: the Red Meerkat and Brown Meerkat. This adorable pair will be accompanied by two brand-new decorations to deck their natural habitat.
  • The Bird House is getting an additional touch of majesticness! You can now meet its two new inhabitants: the Brown Pelican and Dalmatian Pelican!
  • New Fruit Tree: the Pomegranate Tree. Collect mouth-watering Pomegranates, brew sweet Pomegranate Tea at the Tea Kiosk, and bake delicious Pomegranate Cakes in the Cake Oven.

In addition to all the above, we also have:

  • Brand-new Derby decorations.

  • A new expansion area in your Farm, with exclusive decorations!

  • No more multiple taps! Trees and bushes can now be revived with one tap only.
  • New tooltips and interactive links that will guide you directly to buildings and resources. No time to waste!
  • And many more quality of life changes and improvements to make your Farming experience even more aMOOzing!

Not be described in patch note: Easter event with exclusive Decos (April 3th : Alfred will deliver Easter Egg Maker for free to All Players start are lvl 17 or above)

Hay Day is having a holiday in paradise with tropical new delights!

New Fruit Tree!

  • Grow positively divine Guavas with the new Guava Tree!

Cupcake Maker!

More New Products!

  • Whip up a Hearty Winter Stew at the Stew Pot.

More Stuff!

3 October 2022 (v1.55)

Hay Day is bringing the EGGcitement back to the farms with coconuts.. and walruses!

New Sanctuary Animals!

  • Two new Walruses for your visitors to see! Watch them roam around your sanctuary!
  • With the new Sanctuary animals also comes two new decorations - The Labrador Tea and The Icy Bath!

Birdytime!

  • The update also brings you two new birds - The amazing Sulphur Crested Cockatoo & Major Mitchell's Cockatoo!

More products incoming!

  • Tropical Fondue (For the Fondue Pot).
